name: EnhancedFin
description: Ratings, watchlist, resume, follows and release calendar for Jellyfin users.
overview: A personal layer on top of your library, keyed on TMDB: ratings, watchlist, continue watching, followed shows and a release calendar. Powers the discovery features of the SweetFin iOS client.

versions.changelog:
Explore: new "Show trending titles" setting (on by default) to hide the weekly trends row in clients.
Removed: the ASS to SRT subtitle conversion task and its settings; clients now render ASS subtitles themselves.

Next Up: when several episodes are marked as watched at once, the furthest one is used; episodes opened below the server's minimum resume percentage no longer move a show back.
Continue Watching: a next episode is only suggested when it can be played on this server.
Logos: French (France) logos are preferred, then English; Quebec logos are only used as a last resort. Media pages are refreshed once to apply it.
Fix: the "To rate" list now updates as soon as an episode or movie is marked watched or unwatched (it could lag by up to two minutes).

Adds GET /me/next-up/{key}: the next episode to watch of a show (in progress,
otherwise the one after the last watched, otherwise S1E1).
Continue watching now lists the next episode of a show whose last episode is
watched, with the episode name, and ignores items below the server's resume
threshold (MinResumePct), like Jellyfin.
Adds the IMDb id and the original language to the media details.
Adds the TMDB attribution (logo and notice) to the settings page.
